name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften the sliced onion and pepper in olive oil over medium heat.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook for a minute until fragrant.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each one.
Cover and cook gently until the whites set but the yolks stay soft, then serve with bread.

name: Chicken Pad Thai
steps: Soak the rice noodles in warm water until pliable, then drain.
Stir-fry the sliced chicken in a hot wok until cooked through.
Push the chicken aside, scramble the eggs, then combine.
Add the noodles with fish sauce, tamarind, and sugar, tossing over high heat.
Fold through the bean sprouts and finish with crushed peanuts.

name: Simple Miso Soup
steps: Warm the dashi stock in a pot without letting it boil.
Whisk the miso paste with a ladle of warm stock until smooth, then stir it back in.
Add the cubed tofu and heat through gently.
Slice the spring onions and nori into thin strips.
Ladle into bowls and top with the onions and nori.

name: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Grate the pear and garlic, then mix with soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil.
Marinate the sliced beef in the mixture for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a griddle or heavy pan until very hot.
Sear the beef in batches so it caramelises rather than steams.
Scatter with sliced spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Baked Falafel Wrap
steps: Blitz the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, and cumin into a coarse paste.
Stir in the flour and shape the mixture into small patties.
Arrange on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Warm the flatbreads while the falafel finishes baking.
Fill each wrap with falafel, salad, and a spoonful of tahini.

name: Provencal Ratatouille
steps: Chop the aubergine, courgettes, and pepper into bite-sized pieces.
Soften the onion in olive oil, then brown the vegetables in batches.
Return everything to the pot with the tomatoes and herbs.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Season well and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry
steps: Coat the chicken in flour, then egg, then panko breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry the chicken until golden and cooked through, then rest.
Soften the diced onion, stir in the curry powder, and cook briefly.
Add the stock and simmer into a smooth, glossy sauce.
Slice the chicken, pour over the sauce, and serve with rice.

name: Black Bean Quesadilla
steps: Mash the drained beans lightly with the cumin and a pinch of salt.
Spread the beans over half of each tortilla and add pepper and cheese.
Fold the tortillas over into half-moons.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Tom Kha Gai
steps: Simmer the stock with bruised lemongrass and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add the sliced chicken and cook until just done.
Stir in the mushrooms and coconut milk and heat through.
Finish with lime juice and a splash of fish sauce to taste.
Serve hot, discarding the lemongrass and galangal.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella into even rounds.
Arrange them alternately on a platter.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper just before serving.

name: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Fry the sliced onion in ghee until deep golden, then set aside half for garnish.
Stir the vegetables and spice mix into the remaining onion.
Add the yogurt and cook for a couple of minutes.
Rinse the rice, add it with the stock, and bring to a boil.
Cover and steam on low for 15 minutes, then fluff and top with the reserved onion.

name: Crispy Fish Tacos
steps: Season the fish and pan-fry until crisp and flaky.
Mix the mayonnaise with chipotle paste and a squeeze of lime.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Flake the fish and pile it onto the tortillas with cabbage.
Drizzle with the chipotle mayo and finish with lime.

name: Minestrone Soup
steps: Dice the onion, carrots, and celery and soften them in olive oil.
Add the tomatoes and stock and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the beans and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender.
Season well and serve with grated cheese if you like.

name: Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, mirin, honey, and ginger into a glaze.
Sear the salmon skin-side down in a hot pan.
Flip the fillets and pour in the glaze.
Spoon the bubbling sauce over the fish until it thickens.
Serve over rice with the pan sauce drizzled on top.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Halve the peppers and remove the seeds.
Soften the diced onion in olive oil, then stir in the rice and tomatoes.
Spoon the filling into the pepper halves.
Crumble feta over the top and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake at 190C for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender.

name: Beef Pho
steps: Simmer the broth with ginger and star anise for 20 minutes.
Soak the rice noodles until soft and divide between bowls.
Lay the raw beef slices over the noodles.
Strain the hot broth and ladle it over to cook the beef.
Top with basil and serve with lime wedges.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Slice the aubergines, coat in breadcrumbs, and bake until golden.
Spread a layer of tomato sauce in a baking dish.
Layer the aubergine, sauce, and cheeses, repeating to fill the dish.
Finish with mozzarella and parmesan on top.
Bake at 190C for 25 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Sizzling Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers, and onion into strips.
Toss the chicken with the fajita seasoning.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until browned, then set aside.
Stir-fry the peppers and onion until charred at the edges.
Return the chicken, combine, and serve with warm tortillas.

name: Loaded Hummus Bowl
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil until smooth.
Loosen the hummus with a little cold water for a creamy texture.
Spread the hummus across a shallow bowl.
Top with diced cucumber and a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve with warm flatbread for scooping.

name: Ginger Beef Stir-Fry
steps: Sear the beef strips in a very hot wok, then remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli and pepper until bright and crisp-tender.
Add the ginger and cook for thirty seconds.
Return the beef with the soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente, then rinse under cold water.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and mozzarella pearls.
Toss the pasta with the tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil and season generously.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

name: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the sliced chicken and cook until sealed.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and the chopped aubergine.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Season with fish sauce, stir in basil, and serve with rice.

name: Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Soften the diced onion in oil, then stir in the chili powder.
Add the cubed sweet potato and coat in the spices.
Tip in the tomatoes and beans with a splash of water.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Season and serve with rice or crusty bread.

name: Classic French Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt until fully combined.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently with a spatula.
When just set but still soft, fold the omelette into thirds.
Slide onto a plate and scatter with chives.

name: Lemon Quinoa Salad
steps: Rinse the quinoa and cook in salted water until fluffy, then cool.
Dice the cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Chop the parsley finely.
Toss everything with lemon juice and olive oil.
Season to taste and serve chilled.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Soften the diced onion, carrots, and celery in a large pot.
Add the chicken and stock and bring to a gentle boil.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked, then shred it and return it.
Add the noodles and cook until tender.
Season well and serve piping hot.

name: Roasted Veg Buddha Bowl
steps: Roast the cubed sweet potato and chickpeas with olive oil at 200C for 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa until fluffy.
Massage the kale with a little oil until softened.
Loosen the tahini with water and lemon into a dressing.
Assemble the bowls and drizzle with tahini dressing.

name: Beef Lasagna
steps: Brown the beef with the diced onion, then stir in the tomato sauce.
Simmer the ragu for 20 minutes to deepen the flavour.
Layer ragu, pasta sheets, and bechamel in a baking dish.
Repeat the layers and finish with bechamel and cheese.
Bake at 190C for 35 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Garlic Shrimp Scampi
steps: Cook the linguine until al dente and reserve some pasta water.
Sizzle the garlic in butter until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Pour in the wine and lemon juice and simmer briefly.
Toss the pasta through with a splash of pasta water and serve.

name: Vegetable Bibimbap
steps: Saute the julienned carrot, spinach, and mushrooms separately.
Fry the eggs so the yolks stay runny.
Divide the warm rice between two bowls.
Arrange the vegetables in sections over the rice.
Top with a fried egg and a spoonful of gochujang.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Season and grill the chicken until cooked, then slice.
Chop the romaine and place in a large bowl.
Toss the leaves with the caesar dressing.
Add the croutons and shaved parmesan.
Top with the sliced chicken and serve.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Simmer the rinsed lentils with turmeric until soft and creamy.
Heat the ghee and fry the cumin seeds until they pop.
Add the onion and cook until golden, then stir in the tomatoes.
Pour the tempered spices into the lentils.
Simmer briefly, season, and serve with rice or flatbread.

name: Smashed Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread the avocado generously over the toast.
Sprinkle with chili flakes.
Serve straight away while the toast is warm.

name: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Mix the yogurt, spice, garlic, and lemon into a marinade.
Coat the chicken and marinate for at least an hour.
Roast or pan-fry the chicken until charred and cooked.
Rest, then slice the chicken thinly.
Serve in warm gluten-free flatbreads with salad and sauce.

name: Gnocchi Tomato Bake
steps: Toss the gnocchi with the tomato sauce in a baking dish.
Scatter torn mozzarella over the top.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling.
Finish with fresh basil before serving.

name: Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Blitz the cauliflower into rice-sized pieces.
Scramble the eggs in a hot pan, then set aside.
Stir-fry the cauliflower and peas until tender.
Return the eggs and add the tamari.
Toss with sliced spring onions and serve.

name: Vegetable Tagine
steps: Soften the diced onion, then stir in the ras el hanout.
Add the cubed squash and coat in the spices.
Tip in the chickpeas, apricots, and stock.
Simmer for 30 minutes until the squash is tender.
Season and serve with couscous.

name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, and baking powder together.
Beat in the buttermilk, egg, and melted butter until just combined.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Cook spoonfuls in a buttered pan until bubbles form, then flip.
Stack and serve with maple syrup.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Stir the flour, cocoa, and sugar together in a large mug.
Mix in the milk and oil until smooth.
Microwave on high for about 90 seconds until risen.
Let it cool for a minute so it sets.
Eat straight from the mug with a spoon.

name: Spanish Tortilla
steps: Slice the potatoes and onion thinly and cook slowly in the oil until soft.
Drain, reserving the oil, and mix the potatoes into the beaten eggs.
Pour into a hot oiled pan and cook over low heat until nearly set.
Flip using a plate and cook the other side.
Slide out and rest before slicing into wedges.

name: Cold Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, then rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili oil into a sauce.
Loosen the sauce with a splash of warm water.
Toss the noodles through the sauce.
Top with sliced spring onions and serve cold.

name: Herb Baked Cod
steps: Place the cod fillets in an oiled baking dish.
Drizzle with olive oil and scatter over the minced garlic.
Squeeze lemon juice over the top.
Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the fish flakes.
Finish with chopped parsley and serve.

name: Three Bean Vegan Chili
steps: Soften the diced onion in oil, then stir in the chili powder.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Tip in all the drained beans.
Simmer for 20 minutes to thicken.
Season and serve with rice or tortilla chips.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt and half the spice mix.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until charred at the edges.
Soften the onion, add the rest of the spice, then the tomatoes.
Simmer the sauce, then stir in the cream.
Add the chicken and warm through before serving with rice.

name: Zucchini Fritters
steps: Grate the courgettes and squeeze out the excess moisture.
Mix with the egg, flour, and crumbled feta.
Heat the oil in a wide pan.
Fry spoonfuls of the batter until golden on both sides.
Drain on paper towel and serve with a yogurt dip.

name: Classic Beef Burger
steps: Shape the beef into four patties and season well.
Cook on a hot griddle for a few minutes each side.
Add a slice of cheddar to melt over each patty.
Toast the buns lightly.
Build the burgers with tomato and lettuce, then serve.

name: Coconut Rice Pudding
steps: Combine the rice, coconut milk, and plant milk in a pot.
Simmer gently, stirring often, until the rice is creamy.
Stir in the sugar and vanilla.
Cook for a few more minutes until thick.
Serve warm or chilled with fruit.

name: Caprese Stuffed Chicken
steps: Cut a pocket into each chicken breast.
Stuff with sliced mozzarella, tomato, and basil.
Secure with a toothpick and season the outside.
Sear in olive oil, then finish in a 190C oven for 15 minutes.
Rest briefly before serving.

name: Fresh Veggie Spring Rolls
steps: Soak the rice vermicelli noodles until soft, then drain.
Julienne the carrot and cucumber into thin strips.
Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water until pliable.
Lay noodles, vegetables, and herbs across the centre and roll tightly.
Repeat and serve with a dipping sauce.

name: Baked Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook the macaroni until just shy of al dente.
Make a roux with the butter and flour, then whisk in the milk.
Stir in most of the cheddar until smooth.
Fold the pasta through the sauce and tip into a baking dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and remaining cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

name: Salmon Poke Bowl
steps: Cube the salmon and toss with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Divide the warm rice between two bowls.
Slice the avocado and cucumber.
Arrange the salmon and vegetables over the rice.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve.

name: Potato Leek Soup
steps: Soften the sliced leeks in butter without colouring.
Add the diced potatoes and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Blend until smooth and stir in the cream.
Season to taste and serve warm.

name: Crispy Tofu Stir-Fry
steps: Press the tofu, cube it, and toss in cornflour.
Fry the tofu until crisp and golden, then set aside.
Stir-fry the pepper and pak choi until crisp-tender.
Return the tofu with the soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve over rice or noodles.

name: Classic Banana Bread
steps: Mash the bananas in a large bowl.
Beat in the eggs, sugar, and melted butter.
Fold in the flour and baking soda until just combined.
Pour into a lined loaf tin.
Bake at 175C for 50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

name: Prawn Laksa
steps: Fry the laksa paste in a little oil until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk and stock and bring to a simmer.
Cook the prawns in the broth until pink.
Soak the noodles and divide between bowls.
Ladle over the broth and top with bean sprouts.

name: Roasted Vegetable Frittata
steps: Roast the chopped vegetables in olive oil until soft.
Beat the eggs and season well.
Pour the eggs over the vegetables in an ovenproof pan.
Crumble feta on top and cook on the hob until the edges set.
Finish under the grill until puffed and golden.

name: Apple Crumble
steps: Peel and slice the apples and toss with a little sugar.
Tip the apples into a baking dish.
Rub the butter into the flour, then stir in the oats and sugar.
Scatter the crumble over the apples.
Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Fry the diced onion until soft and golden.
Stir in the garam masala and cumin until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and cook down for 5 minutes.
Tip in the chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Season and serve with rice or flatbread.

name: Baked Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, and garlic with seasoning.
Roll into evenly sized meatballs.
Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until browned.
Warm the tomato sauce in a pan.
Add the meatballs to the sauce and simmer briefly before serving.

name: Tomato Bruschetta
steps: Dice the tomatoes and mix with chopped basil and olive oil.
Slice the baguette and toast the pieces.
Rub each toast with a cut clove of garlic.
Spoon the tomato mixture on top.
Drizzle with a little more olive oil and serve.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp
steps: Heat the olive oil and sizzle the sliced garlic.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and curled.
Squeeze in the lemon juice.
Toss through chopped parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice.
